verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own rule-driven automation, but only within spend management. Admins set spend rules and limits that are auto-enforced on every transaction, including automatically blocking out-of-policy purchases. Multi-level approval flows keyed on amount, vendor and role are routed automatically, and a review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and escalates exceptions. All of this is marketing-level, though, and limited to predefined policy and approval actions rather than a general event-to-action rule builder; webhooks and Zapier/Workato recipes are developer building blocks and third-party tools, not first-party rules. missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined trigger/action rule engine beyond spend policy and approvals, technical documentation of rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
